result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 1 FOUND, 4 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Reviewed Java security configuration, properties, Compose, Oracle initialization, Azure setup and sample environment settings with values redacted. Runtime credentials are externally provided or generated; .env.example uses explicit placeholders. No hard-coded active password/key identified. Deployment filesystem ACLs and generated .env permissions were not verified; no credential values reproduced.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password
values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging

evidence.explanation: Authenticated photo upload/deletion events are logged with filename/photo ID, but omit the acting authenticated principal and client attribution. DetailController.deletePhoto and PhotoServiceImpl.deletePhoto record successful destruction without identifying the actor; upload logging has the same gap. SecurityConfig configures HTTP Basic without an application authentication-event audit listener or durable audit sink. This confirms missing application audit detail for destructive security-critical actions; framework/infrastructure logs and production logging configuration were not dynamically verified.

values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
